note: PLACEHOLDER (SND-13 for its recordings): one lampman remark per FallCause, never naming a variant. RSC-06 owns this bank and writes several lines per cause.

strings.lampman.remark.moth_smother: 'Somebody's lamp drew it down on them. Keep them low.'
strings.lampman.remark.blast: 'Naked flame where the gas lies. Gauze lamps, lads.'
strings.lampman.remark.blackdamp: 'Watch your flame. When it shrinks, you get out.'
strings.lampman.remark.shot_dead: 'A gun below does more harm than good.'
